title: Suavae Salt E-Liquid – Pomegranate 30ml
description:
Description
Fresh pomegranate with the perfect amount of tart to tantalize your taste buds!
Suavae is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Suavae E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
30ml Bottle
50% PG 50% VG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Suavae is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
